messages:
sam: Morning — quick oncall note: small router patch scheduled for 09:30 UTC today. Low-risk config change, but we want coverage for the 09:30-10:30 window. @maya @leo can you watch?

maya: I can take 09:30-11:00. What's the rollback plan?

sam: Rollback is a single config flip on the router service. Command: ```curl -X POST https://infra.example.internal/admin/config -d '{"routing_mode":"legacy"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY'```

leo: I'll run the smoke scripts and keep an eye on latency dashboards (https://grafana.example.com/d/ops/latency). If we see tail latency > 250ms for >5m I'll escalate.

infra-bot: Job scheduled: router-config-patch @ 2026-08-04T09:30:00Z. CI job id: ci-482199. Notifications will post here at start/end.

sam: Note: this patch does not touch DB schemas. However, embeddings-rollout (later today) has a background index job — if you see increased DB queue depth, consider scaling replicas. Quick scale command: `kubectl scale deployment db-worker --replicas=4 -n prod`

maya: I'll add a temporary alert: errors > 1% or 5xx spike -> page oncall (oncall escalation = sam then leo). I'll also run the post-deploy smoke in the runbook.

nina: FYI I'm swapping coverage: I was covering 08:00-10:00 but need to shift that to 10:00-16:00; @sam can you confirm swap?

sam: Confirmed @nina, thanks. Adding you to the watchlist for 10:00 onward.

leo: Smoke checklist I'm running after deploy: 1) GET /health 2) POST /v1/generate quick prompt 3) embedding sample call 4) tail logs for router pod. Snippets: `curl -sS https://api.prod/health` and `python tests/smoke/generate_smoke.py`

sam: Final: brief local freeze from 09:25-09:40 (no unrelated infra changes). If rollback occurs, notify #eng-oncall and run the curl flip above. I'll be oncall and reachable on my mobile during window. :thumbsup:
